computedeck.description: Multi-node GPU control plane in VS Code: cluster tree, status bar, node/job actions, terminal, diagnostics, and MCP.
computedeck.mcp.label: ComputeDeck
computedeck.config.title: ComputeDeck
computedeck.config.apiBase: Control plane URL. Use 127.0.0.1 with VS Code Remote SSH; use an SSH tunnel URL when connecting from the local machine.
computedeck.config.pollIntervalSec: Status bar / cluster tree refresh interval (seconds).
computedeck.config.statusBar: Show online nodes and free GPUs in the status bar.
computedeck.config.mcpPath: Path to gpu-control-mcp for registering the MCP Server with VS Code / Copilot.
computedeck.config.sshUser: Default SSH user for node terminals. Leave empty to use ansible_user from nodes.json.
computedeck.walkthrough.title: Get Started with ComputeDeck
computedeck.walkthrough.description: Connect to the control plane, read the cluster tree, then open terminals, run diagnostics, and deploy jobs from VS Code.
computedeck.walkthrough.connect.title: Connect to the Control Plane
computedeck.walkthrough.connect.descript:
Set the control plane URL and sign in. With Remote SSH this is usually 127.0.0.1.
[Password Login](command:computedeck.login)
[Set API Token](command:computedeck.setToken)
computedeck.walkthrough.connect.alt: Connect to the ComputeDeck control plane
computedeck.walkthrough.cluster.title: Read the Cluster Tree
computedeck.walkthrough.cluster.descript: Overview, nodes, jobs, queue/leases, and ingress; the status bar keeps node and free-GPU counts visible.
computedeck.walkthrough.nodes.title: Node Terminals and Diagnostics
computedeck.walkthrough.nodes.descriptio:
Use the context menu or inline buttons to open an SSH terminal, run read-only diagnostics, cordon, or free a node.
[Node Actions](command:computedeck.nodeMenu)
computedeck.walkthrough.jobs.title: Deploy and Control Jobs
computedeck.walkthrough.jobs.description:
Auto-pick nodes by GPU count, or deploy to a specific node. Start, restart, or stop jobs inline.
[Deploy Job](command:computedeck.deployJob)
computedeck.walkthrough.mcp.title: Copilot and Web Dashboard
computedeck.walkthrough.mcp.description:
After registering the MCP Server, Copilot / Claude can call gc_* tools. The full dashboard stays in the browser.
[Register MCP Server](command:computedeck.installMcp)
[Open Web Control Plane](command:computedeck.openDashboard)
computedeck.config.autoLocalAuth: When this workspace is the control plane repo, automatically load config/local/secrets/ui_api_token.
computedeck.config.controlRoot: Path to the local ComputeDeck control plane repo. Leave empty to detect the workspace or ~/gpu-control.
computedeck.welcome.disconnected:
Control plane not connected. On the control host, local Token is used automatically.
[Use Local Token](command:computedeck.useLocalCredentials)
[Password Login](command:computedeck.login)
[Open Web Control Plane](command:computedeck.openDashboard)
[Open Getting Started](command:computedeck.openWalkthrough)
